footnote_text: This transaction represents the vesting on November 4, 2026 of 25,000 Restricted Stock Units ("RSUs") granted on November 4, 2025 under the Company's 2021 Equity Incentive Plan (as amended and restated on April 22, 2024) and reported on the Form 3 filed February 13, 2026, as amended pursuant to Form 3/A filed on May 11, 2026. This relates to the vesting of the first of three equal annual installments (further details in Note 4 below). Each RSU represents the right to receive one share of Common Stock. These 25,000 RSUs were settled in shares of Common Stock on November 4, 2026.

This transaction represents 6,088 shares of Common Stock withheld for tax obligations in connection with the settlement on November 4, 2026 of 25,000 RSUs that vested on November 4, 2026 (the first of three equal annual installments). The vesting of those 25,000 RSUs is described in Note 1 above. || The 18,912 shares of Common Stock beneficially owned following the reported transactions reflects: (i) 25,000 shares acquired upon vesting of RSUs on November 4, 2026 (Note 1 above); less (v) 6,088 shares withheld for tax upon settlement of RSUs on November 4, 2026 (Note 2 above).

This transaction represents the vesting on November 4, 2026, of 33,333 Restricted Stock Units ("RSUs") granted on November 4, 2025, under the Company's 2021 Equity Incentive Plan (as amended and restated on April 22, 2024) and reported on the Form 4 filed November 25, 2025. This relates to the vesting of the first of three equal annual installments (further details in Note 4 below). Each RSU represents the right to receive one share of Common Stock. These 33,333 RSUs were settled in shares of Common Stock on November 4, 2026.

This transaction represents 8,117 shares of Common Stock withheld for tax obligations in connection with the settlement of November 4, 2026, of 33,333 RSUs that vested on November 4, 2026 (the first of three annual installments). The vesting of those 33,333 RSUs is described in Note 1. || The 87,499 shares of Common Stock beneficially owned following the reported transaction reflects: (i) 33,333 shares acquired upon vesting of RSUs on November 4, 2026 (Note 1 above); less (ii) 8,117 shares withheld for tax upon settlement of RSUs on November 4, 2026 (Note 2 above).
